<thought>To obtain the possible precursors, I will first locate a retrosynthetic template that matches the intramolecular carbonyl‑ene transformation described. The forward reaction breaks a ketone (C=O) and an alkene (C=C), and forms a new C‑C bond while creating an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring. Using the available functional‑group names, I will search the template catalog with these criteria, then apply the found template to the target molecule to generate the precursor SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
